references.title: Neuf icônes d'inventaire
references.prompt: Create a polished game art demonstration sheet: exactly nine distinct fantasy dungeon inventory item icons in a perfectly regular 3 by 3 grid, no words or lettering. Each icon fully separated with generous margins, equal scale and centered in its own invisible cell, on a uniform solid midnight navy background #101824, no card frames. Row 1: ruby health potion in round glass bottle, icy blue mana potion in triangular glass bottle, jade poison vial. Row 2: ancient bronze dungeon key with a skull bow, short iron sword with a worn leather grip, folded parchment dungeon map tied with red cord. Row 3: small oak treasure chest bound with brass, luminous violet crystal cluster, silver ring with an emerald. Cohesive handcrafted stylized fantasy RPG art, charming chunky silhouettes, hand-painted 3D appearance, readable at small sizes, controlled highlights upper left, exquisite material clarity, warm brass and teal accents. Three-quarter isometric object views; no environmental scene, no characters, no watermarks. These are illustrative item icon concepts.

references.title: Bibliothèque engloutie
references.prompt: An evocative environment concept for a stylized fantasy dungeon game, a forgotten flooded underground library seen from a high three-quarter isometric game camera. A small raised stone walkway leads from the lower left past broken shelves and amber candles to a monumental circular portal carved into a wall on the right. The portal glows teal, lighting suspended dust and shallow water; ancient bronze mechanisms and hanging roots frame it. Strong spatial readability, large clean shapes, modest stylization, beautiful detailed hand-painted game art. Single cohesive game environment, no UI, no writing, no characters. Blue-black slate stone, turquoise magic, warm honey light. Visually legible navigable floor, contrasting lit focus at the portal, carefully composed 16:9 scene. This is a mood and environment concept illustration, not a technical level map.

halts.title: Le camp des compagnons
halts.generation_prompt:
Create a finished game environment illustration for the clickable rest destination "Le camp des compagnons" in a Greek mythic underworld tactical RPG. Match the supplied submerged-library reference EXTREMELY closely in painting style, large clean readable chunky stone forms, refined hand-painted 3D appearance, subtle colored contours, graduated shadow and polished selective highlights. Blue-black petrol slate, warm honey candle/fire light, aged oxidized brass, restrained olive moss, subtle cyan magic. No flat cel shading, no thick black cartoon contours, no photorealism.
High three-quarter isometric view of an intimate ancient stone courtyard suspended just above very dark teal still water, with a broken classical portico, an old twisted olive tree and red-brown linen canopy. Companions have left beautiful equipment and offerings, but show NO characters so the player's hero can be imagined visiting. Strong spatial readability and a walkable stone path linking four clear service areas.
Composition is a wide stage, leaving about 8 percent unimportant outer margin so it can be cropped to 16:10. Service object anchors measured as percentages of full image width,height: near (22%,48%) a beautifully arranged bronze repair-and-trade bench under a linen awning, with sword, amphora, small closed chest and brass scales; near (50%,72%) a low circular brazier with glowing amber coals, two simple resting seats and carefully piled travel blankets; near (79%,43%) a large ancient inscribed memory stele surrounded by turquoise votive lamps and laurel; near (78%,79%) a low round offering basin with a floating cyan oath crystal for discovery. These four anchors must be clearly separated and inviting, ample dark negative space below each for interface labels added later. No readable writing, no UI, no buttons, no labels, no text. Fine decorative carvings are abstract. Architectural background mostly upper quarter; important foreground objects are fully inside frame. Soft dark vignette only at outside edges. The environment should feel as lovingly painted, atmospheric and materially precise as the approved submerged library reference, while being its own warm sheltered companion camp.
halts.export_transform: uniform scale + central crop, no anisotropic distortion
